column1: # How to SAY words that Uzbek text borrows from other languages.
# Format: written<TAB>spoken (Uzbek spelling). Whole word, case-sensitive.
# A key written in lowercase also matches its Capitalised form at a sentence start.
# Applied before numbers, so keys may hold digits (4G, IPv4). Edit freely: this is your pronunciation dictionary.
# A key ending in * is a word stem: it also covers the word with suffixes (sentabr* -> sentabrda, sentabrga, ...).
# Russian loans written without the soft vowel the 1995 spelling dropped; people say them with it (the owner flagged
# «oktabr, sentabr» on 2026-11-14: the model read them stiffly, «sentabirga»).
# (Model-only tricks such as «ya» -> «yaa» live in uznorm/respell.py, not here: this file is real pronunciation.)
